root_idea.summary: The root centers on remaining or lingering in a place, implying continued presence over time.
root_idea.development: The basic idea of staying develops into tarrying, waiting, pausing, and delay. Classical usage also includes causative and evaluative branches connected with making or judging someone slow to proceed.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form لَبِثَ.
Displayed as the singular active-participle citation form لَابِثٌ; the supplied Quran occurrence is plural.

senses.definition: To remain, stay, or abide in a place or for a stated period.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for continued presence or residence, including remaining somewhere for a measured duration or reporting how long someone has stayed.

senses.definition: To tarry, pause, or delay before proceeding.
senses.usage_conditions: The sense emphasizes a pause or delay rather than simple continued residence; in a context involving an intended action, it may be rendered as hesitating.
An active participle describing one who remains; the supplied Quran occurrence is the masculine plural لَابِثِينَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wait, expect, or remain patiently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical use in which tarrying involves waiting for or expecting something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the construction مَا لَبِثَ أَنْ، not to delay or be slow to do something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction meaning that an action followed without delay.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wait for someone while leaving him until his error or poor judgment becomes apparent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the imperative expression اِلْبَثْ عَنْ فُلَانٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone tarry, wait, or remain patient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use corresponding to making another person delay or wait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deem someone or something slow or tardy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An evaluative Form X use describing the subject as judging another person or thing to be slow to proceed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tarrying, stay, stopping, or loitering; a period of waiting or pausing in expectation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun for remaining or lingering, including prolonged stagnation.
An adjectival use describing slowness or lateness rather than the act of remaining.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single act or instance of tarrying, staying, or stopping.
A mode or manner of tarrying, staying, or stopping.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the manner or way in which tarrying occurs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Slow, in a specialized description of a horse or bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transmitted lexical discussion records a reading issue between a slow horse and, in the corrected reading, a slow bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or assembly of people from different tribes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective expression for a socially mixed group.
